lines: Passive tree: the DPS / Defense slider is on the optimizer too. Optimize tree and Plan follow it.
Defence estimate: armour, evasion and block now count, with tick boxes for which defences your build uses (Item Simulator and Passive tree).
Gear Set Sim: two new boxes limit the lines on rares and the Vows on uniques. Empty means 6, as before.
Item Simulator: a DPS / Defense slider. Item Compare now recommends which item to wear from it, and the Gear Set Sim searches with it.
Gear Set Sim: new Reach max resistances option (target 75%, Poison optional).
Build Planner: the Gear tab is gone. Click a slot on the Character tab to pick or edit an item.

Support gems: Spell Totem, Orbit, Rain, Trap, Skyfall and Focused Volley are no longer offered for skills they cannot go into (Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash, Sparks, Woes and others). Trap and Skyfall are offered for the Ballista.
Minions: the zone level bonus now follows the game's own rule, so it depends on the gem's level too. Grave Golem numbers change the most.
Sparks: with several Spark skills on your bar, each one strikes for less on an enemy that carries them all (80% with two, 73% with three, 70% with four).
Movement skills: the cooldown shortens with every gem level and recovers with Dexterity, not cast speed. Mana cost follows the gem's own level, and maximum mana is higher from level 36.
Rare items: crafted and Oathsworn lines are not counted for Great or Flawless and are not boosted. Boosted lines are rounded like in the game.
Traps, Ballistas and very fast skills: re-arm speed past +100% counts in full, Ballista repeats past the second deal 50%, and no skill is used faster than once per 0.12 s.
FAQ: new sections Item Quality, Riven & Mythic (quality stones, cogs, Riven mods, Mythic lines) and Custom Leagues (every league setting and its range).
FAQ, Game Data & Patches: now says the numbers come from the Broken Oath public API.
Ladder: the Keystones and Equipped uniques columns are gone from the table (the Item worn search still finds uniques). The hero view has a Close button.
Riven item mods (54) and Mythic lines (12) are now in the planner, Item Search and the sim. Ladder builds that wear Riven mods count them.
FAQ, Monster Affixes: new table of each Guardian's strong and weak element (+20% / -20%). The sim does not count it yet.
Game data now comes from the Broken Oath public API instead of the game files (game build 70). The numbers are the same as before; the page footer now shows the game build.

Uniques: the game scales some unique lines when it loads them (The Heartwood Girdle, Glass Soul, Kingbreaker, Stormfang and 12 more). Tooltips, Item Search and the sim now use the game's numbers: the Girdle gives 1% more Damage per 1,000 Life (range 0.6-1), not 3%.
Damage Analysis: the modifier list showed {v} in place of the number on some unique lines.
New Configure Enemy button on Damage Analysis, Passive tree, Skills, Gear and Item Simulator: change the target without leaving the page.
The default target is now a Guardian with no element (was a Rare), so DPS numbers read lower until you change it.
Ladder: the list shows the main skill only; support gems are in each hero's build.
Damage: a gem plays at the highest level your attributes meet, as in the game. A skill of another class asks more, so it can play below its gem level; the Damage tab says when it does.
Damage: a spell's 2% per 10 bonus comes from its gem's attribute. Pyre of Faith, Judgement, Orbiting Hammers and Consecrated Ground read Strength, not Intelligence.
Damage: attack or cast speed past a skill's speed cap now becomes damage, and a weapon's Base Grade scales its damage.
Damage: maximum life was one level too high, and the skill panel number counts Ignite the way the game does.
Damage: Strength, Dexterity and Intelligence are rounded to the nearest point, as the game does (they were rounded down, so some characters were 1 short).
Damage: Evasion is now worked out as the game does (2 per Dexterity and a base from your level were missing), so nodes that pay more damage per 1,000 Evasion are worth more than before.
Damage: an armour piece's Base Grade now scales its base Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield.

Passive tree: right-click a node (touch: tap it, then Never take) to mark it never take. It gets a red cross, and Optimize, Plan and the node values skip it and never path through it. Kept per character.
Passive tree: right-click no longer takes a node.
Damage: Glass Cannon sets your Evasion to 0, so nodes that pay more damage per 1,000 Evasion give nothing while it is taken.
Passive tree optimizer: it no longer holds on to a notable only for its life-on-kill line, so it can move those points when they add no damage.
Damage tab: its "Also count" list is now the same one as the Skill tree, Item Simulator and Build Planner (ticks and weights carry over everywhere).
